stories.headline: Meta announces US$9.1B AI data center in Alberta, its first in Canada

key_facts.fact: Meta said on July 8 it will invest more than US$9.1 billion to build its first AI data center in Canada.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta said Wednesday it will invest more than US$9.1 billion to build its first artificial intelligence data center in Canada and its largest outside the United States.

key_facts.fact: The facility will be located in Sturgeon County, Alberta.
key_facts.excerpt: The facility will be built in Sturgeon County, Alberta.

key_facts.fact: The project will be powered by the 932-megawatt Greenlight Electricity Center, expected to start operating in the second half of 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta was identified Wednesday as the customer. The 932-megawatt power plant is expected to begin operating in the second half of 2030.

key_facts.fact: Meta said the data center will use closed-loop cooling and invest US$42 million in local infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta said the data center will use a closed-loop cooling system... The company also plans to invest US$42 million in local infrastructure.

sources.title: Meta plans billions for first AI data center in Canada, largest outside the US

stories.headline: Apple supplier Luxshare raises US$3.07B in Hong Kong listing

key_facts.fact: Luxshare Precision Industry raised HK$24.04 billion, or US$3.07 billion, in Hong Kong's largest IPO of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple supplier Luxshare Precision Industry had a subdued debut in Hong Kong's largest IPO of 2026... raised HK$24.04 billion (US$3.07 billion).

key_facts.fact: Luxshare shares closed 1.55% below the offer price at HK$62.30 in their July 9 trading debut.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares closing 1.55% below the offer price at HK$62.30.

key_facts.fact: The offering had cornerstone backing from Temasek, GIC, and Abu Dhabi Investment Authority.
key_facts.excerpt: Strong backing from cornerstone investors like Temasek, GIC, and Abu Dhabi Investment Authority reflects institutional confidence.

key_facts.fact: Luxshare has been expanding beyond Apple into automotive and AI data-center hardware.
key_facts.excerpt: Luxshare... is actively reducing its dependency on Apple... by expanding into automotive and AI data-center hardware.

sources.title: Apple Supplier Luxshare Has Lackluster Start in Hong Kong's Biggest Listing This Year

stories.headline: SK Hynix's planned US share sale draws more than 7x demand

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix's proposed US share sale drew investor demand of more than seven times the offer size, according to Reuters-based reports on July 9.
key_facts.excerpt: SK Hynix's proposed $28 billion share sale in the United States has received overwhelming interest, with investor demand surpassing the offer by more than seven times, according to a Reuters report.

key_facts.fact: The ADR offering is expected to list on Nasdaq under ticker SKHY.
key_facts.excerpt: The listing of its American depositary receipts (ADRs) on Nasdaq under the ticker SKHY.

key_facts.fact: MarketWatch reported the transaction was expected to raise $25.7 billion and could rank as the second-largest equity issuance ever.
key_facts.excerpt: The offering, expected to raise $25.7 billion, would become the second-largest equity issuance ever.

key_facts.fact: The underwriters were reported as Goldman Sachs, Citi, Bank of America, and JPMorgan.
key_facts.excerpt: The underwriters--Goldman Sachs, Citi, Bank of America, and JPMorgan--are issuing 177.9 million new shares.

stories.headline: China plans limited Nvidia H200 purchases for top AI firms

key_facts.fact: China plans to let some of its biggest AI companies buy a small number of Nvidia H200 chips, according to July 8 reporting.
key_facts.excerpt: China plans to let some of its biggest AI companies buy a small number of Nvidia's H200 chips.

key_facts.fact: The planned purchases are meant to help offset a domestic computing shortage in recent months.
key_facts.excerpt: To offset a domestic computing shortage in recent months.

key_facts.fact: The chips at issue are Nvidia H200 AI accelerators, placing the story in the US-China semiconductor export-control lane.

stories.headline: AI chip startup Positron talks to raise US$750M at up to US$5B value

key_facts.fact: Reno-based AI chip startup Positron was in talks to raise about US$750 million, according to July 8 reporting.
key_facts.excerpt: Sources: Reno-based AI chip startup Positron is in talks to raise ~$750M.

key_facts.fact: The fundraising was structured in two phases, with a first-tranche valuation of US$3.5 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: In two phases, at valuations of $3.5B in the first tranche.

key_facts.fact: The second phase was discussed at a valuation of about US$5 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: And ~$5B in the second.

key_facts.fact: The company is positioned as a Nvidia rival in AI chips.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia Rival Positron Holds Talks to Raise Funds at $5 Billion Valuation.
